entities.summary: Andrej Bagar was a Slovak film and theatre actor and theatre director. He appeared in 16 films between 1935 and 1965. Nitra's theatre, previously known as Krajové divadlo Nitra, took his name, becoming the Andrej Bagar Theatre in 1979.
